symptom: A runtime revoked during provider inspection could still complete a create or wake when inspection found an already-running resource and runtime upgrade handling was absent.
rule: Keep a fresh full generation/runtime-pin check after provider inspection and the stopped-runtime upgrade decision, including no-dispatch results. Database-only batching must retry the entire admission snapshot after a confirmed transaction abort.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/cloud-workspaces/reconciler.integration.test.ts -t 'rechecks a revoked runtime after inspect returns running'
